label: Opening Hook
text: In 1908, an explosion over Siberia flattened about 80 million trees across 2,000 square kilometres, without leaving a crater.
title: File:Tunguska event in east siberia map 2.png

label: Terrain & Scale
text: 30 June 1908, near the Podkamennaya Tunguska River Most likely the airburst of an asteroid or comet several kilometres above the ground Energy estimates range widely, roughly 3 to 30 megatons The first scientific expedition, led by Leonid Kulik, reached the site in 1927 The largest impact event in recorded history
